rationale: The proposed topology improves stability and noise performance by adding a source degeneration resistor to the NMOS transistor, which enhances input matching (S11) and reduces noise figure (NF) by increasing the effective source resistance and improving transconductance linearity. This targeted modification addresses the most negative margin (NF at -1.868) while maintaining low power and broadband operation, and the added resistor helps stabilize the amplifier across the wideband frequency range without violating the device budget or requiring inductors.
